root_cause_verification.rationale: The root cause of AC3 (tool block not rendering) was the mcp__happy__change_title interception in messageToEvent.ts that converted the tool call into a generic 'message' event. This interception has been completely removed. The git diff confirms the removal of the entire block that matched content.name === 'mcp__happy__change_title' and returned { type: 'message', message: 'Title changed to...' }. The tool call now flows through the normal rendering pipeline: reducer.ts Phase 1 -> ToolView -> knownTools.tsx lookup -> visible tool block.
